healthcare.title: Clinics and Healthcare
healthcare.subtitle: Freedom to focus on patient care
healthcare.description:
As a clinic, you know how important it is to give your patients the best treatment. But administrative tasks like phone calls, bookings and cancellations steal valuable time from patient care.

Our AI receptionist handles all customer enquiries professionally — from new bookings to rebookings and confirmations. With automatic SMS reminders, you significantly reduce no-shows. Your personalized dashboard gives you a complete overview: listen to all calls, see short summaries of each conversation, what was agreed, booking statistics and calendar integration. You can keep using your current calendar software — our system syncs automatically.
benefits: Reduce phone time by 85% — focus on your patients instead
Automatic SMS reminders reduce no-shows by up to 60%
Handle bookings, rebookings and cancellations 24/7
Complete dashboard with call history and conversation summaries
Integration with your existing booking system and calendar
Full GDPR compliance for sensitive patient data

craftsman.title: Craftsmen
craftsman.subtitle: Stop losing orders because the phone doesn't get answered
craftsman.description:
You know the feeling: you're in the middle of a job and the phone rings. If you answer it, you lose focus. If you don't, you potentially lose a good order. It's an impossible situation.

Our AI receptionist solves this problem once and for all. The system answers every call, registers customer details, books site visits and sends automatic SMS confirmations. In your dashboard, you can see all enquiries, listen to recorded conversations, get short summaries of what the customer wants, and see what has been agreed. Your calendar updates automatically, no matter which system you use. Stop worrying about lost orders — focus on your craft.
benefits: Answer every enquiry even while you're on a job
Automatic registration of customer details and job descriptions
Book site visits directly in your calendar — syncs automatically
SMS confirmations for both you and the customer
Dashboard with all customer enquiries and what was agreed
Never miss an order again — the system works 24/7

office.title: Office and Administration
office.subtitle: Professional customer service without interruptions
office.description:
In office businesses, concentration and productivity are crucial. But constant phone calls interrupt the workflow and significantly reduce efficiency. At the same time, it's important to give customers fast and professional service.

With Aibooking.dk, you get the best of both worlds. Our AI receptionist screens all incoming calls, handles meeting bookings, answers common questions and only forwards the most important enquiries. Your team gets the peace to work with focus, while customers experience professional service around the clock. The dashboard gives you complete control: listen to all conversations, see detailed summaries, booking statistics and calendar integration. Perfect for lawyers, accountants, consultants and other knowledge-based businesses.
benefits: Reduce interruptions and improve employee productivity
Professional phone service without extra payroll costs
Automatic call screening — only important matters get forwarded
Book meetings directly into the team's shared calendar
Dashboard with conversation history, summaries and statistics
Integration with existing CRM and calendar systems

ecommerce.title: Webshops and E-commerce
ecommerce.subtitle: Customer service that scales with your business
ecommerce.description:
In e-commerce, fast customer service is crucial to success. Delayed responses to customer enquiries mean lost sales and poor reviews. But staffing customer service 24/7 is expensive and complex.

Aibooking.dk gives you AI-powered customer service that never sleeps. The system instantly answers common questions about products, delivery times, returns and order status. Complex enquiries are automatically escalated to your team. With SMS notifications, you keep customers updated throughout the entire purchase journey. Your dashboard shows all customer interactions, conversation summaries, frequent questions and trends, so you can constantly optimize your service. Reduce response times from hours to seconds and significantly improve customer satisfaction.
benefits: Answer customer enquiries instantly 24/7 without extra staff
Handle questions about products, order status and returns automatically
Automatic SMS updates about shipments and deliveries
Reduce response times from hours to seconds
Dashboard with customer interactions, trends and frequent questions
Integration with your webshop system and order management

seoContent.title: AI Receptionist for Danish Businesses
seoContent.intro: Aibooking.dk is Denmark's leading AI receptionist solution, automating customer service, booking and administration for businesses in every industry.

whatIs.title: What is an AI receptionist?
whatIs.paragraph1: An AI receptionist is an intelligent virtual assistant that handles all your customer enquiries automatically around the clock. Our advanced AI technology can answer calls, take bookings, send SMS confirmations, handle rebookings and much more — all without human intervention.
whatIs.paragraph2: Unlike a traditional receptionist, Aibooking.dk works 24/7 without breaks, holidays or sick days. This means your customers can always reach your business, regardless of the time of day. At the same time, you save significant payroll costs and can focus your employees on more value-adding tasks.

healthcare.title: Clinics and Healthcare
healthcare.text: Perfect for doctors, dentists, physiotherapists, psychologists and other healthcare clinics. The AI receptionist handles bookings, reminders and cancellations automatically, while you focus on your patients. Integration with your existing booking system ensures real-time synchronization.

craftsman.title: Craftsmen
craftsman.text: Ideal for plumbers, electricians, carpenters, painters and other trades. Stop losing jobs because you can't answer the phone while you're working. The AI receptionist logs every enquiry, books site visits and sends confirmations automatically.

office.title: Office and Administration
office.text: Optimize administration in your office, law firm, accounting firm or consultancy. The AI receptionist screens calls, books meetings, handles customer enquiries and ensures your employees are only interrupted when it matters.

ecommerce.title: Webshops and E-commerce
ecommerce.text: Give your customers the support they deserve with AI-powered customer service. Answer common questions about products, order status and returns instantly. Reduce response times and significantly improve customer satisfaction.

features.title: Advanced features that make the difference
features.paragraph1: Aibooking.dk is more than just an answering machine. Our platform includes a comprehensive dashboard where you can follow all customer interactions in real time. Listen to all recorded conversations, get short summaries of each conversation, see what has been agreed, and get detailed statistics on bookings and customer enquiries.
features.paragraph2: The system integrates seamlessly with your existing calendar, whether you use Google Calendar, Outlook or an industry-specific solution. You get automatic SMS messages to both you and your customers, so everyone stays updated. And with our intuitive dashboard, you can easily oversee your business and make data-driven decisions.
